name: Imtron Electronics
old_description: Minnesota-based Imtron has supplied high-quality electronic components to manufacturers across the world since 1988.
about:
Imtron Electronics, based in Eden Prairie, Minnesota, has been supplying electronic components since its founding in 1988. The company operates as a stocking distributor and is led by President and General Manager Jeff Spaeth alongside a small team of sales and operations professionals.

The distributor stocks a range of connectors, crystals, thermal-management products, and power supplies from partners such as LEMO, Magtech, TXC, Henkel, and Mornsun. Imtron maintains inventory to serve global customers and emphasizes a consultative approach to help engineers select components for applications where failure is not an option.

Its customer base spans the automotive, aviation, medical, and military sectors. The company’s blog and marketing materials highlight work with medical-grade electronics manufacturers and defense programs that require rugged, compliant components.

Imtron says its differentiation lies in decades of component-sales experience, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a focus on supplying parts that “cannot fail in the field,” backed by technical consultation and long-term supplier relationships.
